candidate_name: Eddystone LNG Export Terminal (Penn America/Eddystone Energy LLC successor)
sponsor_or_proposer: Eddystone Energy LLC (principal Franc James; successor to Penn America Energy)
current_state: Early concept; NDAs with PA DCED and Eddystone Borough reported; no permits filed as of early 2026. Pivot from the shelved Penn LNG (Chester) site to Eddystone, Delaware County PA.
missing_threshold_elements: No filed permit/regulatory application; no confirmed capacity, financing, EPC, feedgas contract, or precise site footprint; entity newly formed.
watch_for: FERC pre-filing or DOE export application; a named site/parcel in Eddystone; capacity disclosure; any state environmental permit filing.
notes: Likely the same effort GEM tracks as Penn LNG, relocated. Do NOT create a new terminal yet (below add-bar). Re-link to Penn LNG Terminal record if it materializes there; otherwise candidate for Discovery once a concrete regulatory step appears.
